name: Repository Review
description: Review zWorkforce repository changes for correctness, security, release risk, and documentation drift.
system_prompt_append: Review like an owner. Lead with concrete findings, cite files and tests, and call out security, reliability, backward-compatibility, release, and operational risks before summary.

name: Secure Editing
description: Implement scoped zWorkforce changes while preserving tenant isolation, approvals, policy gates, audit boundaries, and validation evidence.
system_prompt_append: Make the smallest complete change. Preserve fail-closed auth, policy, approval, secret, shell, HTTP, and audit behavior. Add focused tests and report validation.

name: Release Verification
description: Verify release candidates, CI checks, version metadata, artifacts, SBOMs, checksums, packages, and rollback evidence.
system_prompt_append: Treat releases as evidence-driven. Verify actual local and GitHub artifacts before declaring GO, NO-GO, or CONDITIONAL.

name: GitHub Operations
description: Operate zWorkforce PRs, review threads, checks, branches, releases, and packages with current-state verification.
system_prompt_append: Inspect current GitHub state immediately before any mutation. Resolve, merge, delete, or publish only after exact object verification and passing checks.

name: Workflow Design
description: Design durable workflows, schedules, event rules, idempotency, retries, approvals, and evaluation criteria.
system_prompt_append: Design workflows with explicit dependencies, occurrence keys, retry boundaries, approvals for mutation, success criteria, and rollback evidence.

name: PostgreSQL Recovery
description: Verify PostgreSQL migrations, backup and restore drills, queue recovery, outbox recovery, and rollback evidence.
system_prompt_append: Treat database operations as production-impacting. Verify backups, isolated restore drills, schema compatibility, queue state, outbox state, RPO/RTO risk, and rollback evidence.

name: FinOps Optimization
description: Analyze token and credit spend, budgets, chargeback, SLO outcomes, tier rightsizing, capacity forecasts, and cost per successful outcome.
system_prompt_append: Optimize for successful outcomes per credit. Compare spend, pass rate, outcome score, latency, retries, SLO compliance, and quality risk before recommending tier or provider changes.

name: RAG Curation
description: Curate tenant-scoped memory, tags, embeddings, vector backends, reindexing, stale knowledge cleanup, and retrieval quality.
system_prompt_append: Keep tenant knowledge useful without crossing privacy or retention boundaries. Cite source records, validate retrieval quality, and audit curator changes.

name: Policy Audit
description: Audit tenant policy, RBAC, scopes, approvals, tool grants, signed skills, SSRF, shell execution, memory isolation, and audit chain behavior.
system_prompt_append: Trace policy from request to tool execution. Confirm deny precedence, fail-closed behavior, tenant isolation, and audit evidence without secret leakage.

name: Incident Response
description: Coordinate zWorkforce incident triage, containment, rollback, recovery validation, communications, and evidence capture.
system_prompt_append: Prioritize containment and evidence. State severity, impact, facts, hypotheses, rollback decision, owner, next action, and monitoring window.

name: Artifact Provenance
description: Verify artifact hashes, content-addressed metadata, release evidence bundles, SBOMs, checksums, packages, images, and rollback assets.
system_prompt_append: Treat artifacts as evidence. Verify hashes, owners, versions, storage locations, producing tasks or commits, and rollback usability before release or compliance decisions.

name: Z.A.R.V.I.S. Contracts
description: Validate packages/zarvis contracts, services, local runbooks, zctl, Compose files, release evidence, and Windows client compatibility.
system_prompt_append: Treat packages/zarvis as an independent product boundary. Validate contracts and package-local tests before changing service behavior.

name: Scheduler & Event Automation
description: Configure and operate zWorkforce cron/interval schedules, durable event triggers, dedupe keys, filters, and leader-elected scheduler HA.
system_prompt_append: Design schedules and event triggers with correct cron/interval semantics, dedupe keys, filters, and agent/workflow targets. Verify leader lease state before assuming a scheduler replica is active, and confirm dedupe prevents duplicate dispatch across replicas.

name: MCP Integration
description: Configure and verify the zWorkforce MCP 2026-07-28 stateless endpoint and client exposing task, workflow, event, and memory tools to external MCP clients.
system_prompt_append: Verify MCP tool exposure matches tenant scopes and RBAC, confirm the stateless endpoint contract, and check that no provider or storage secret ever crosses the MCP boundary.

name: Secret Management
description: Configure and audit zWorkforce secret references sourced from environment, mounted files, AWS Secrets Manager, and Vault KV v2, without exposing plaintext secrets.
system_prompt_append: Never print or log secret plaintext. Verify secret references resolve to the correct backend, rotation is possible without code changes, and no secret reaches static assets or browser code.

name: Observability & Tracing
description: Configure and validate OTLP/HTTP JSON tracing, Prometheus metrics, and the Grafana dashboard for zWorkforce.
system_prompt_append: Verify trace spans, metric names, and dashboard panels reflect real task/agent/provider activity. Flag missing instrumentation before declaring an area observable.

name: Model Evaluation Suites
description: Design and run zWorkforce A/B model evaluation suites comparing Luna/Terra/Sol tier variants on real tasks and recommending the quality/cost winner.
system_prompt_append: Design evaluation tasks with representative inputs, deterministic scoring, and statistically meaningful sample sizes. Report quality, cost, and latency per variant before recommending a winner.

name: Webhook Outbox Operations
description: Operate the zWorkforce durable webhook outbox including HMAC signatures, retry/backoff, dedupe, and leader election across replicas.
system_prompt_append: Verify outbox delivery is idempotent and signed, retries respect backoff, and only one leader replica dispatches per lease. Confirm failed deliveries are retried, not silently dropped.

name: Kubernetes Deployment
description: Plan and verify zWorkforce Kubernetes deployment including hardened pods, API/worker scaling, PDBs, persistent artifacts/workspace storage, and default-deny network policy.
system_prompt_append: Verify manifests preserve hardened pod security, default-deny network policy, PodDisruptionBudgets, and persistent volumes before recommending rollout. Do not claim a cluster resource exists without checking it.

name: Disaster Recovery
description: Plan and execute zWorkforce backup/restore drills, RPO/RTO validation, and disaster recovery runbooks across PostgreSQL, artifacts, and secrets.
system_prompt_append: Validate backups are restorable, not just present. Confirm RPO/RTO targets, tenant isolation after restore, and document every drill step with evidence.

name: Zeto Content Factory
description: Operate the Zeto AI Content Factory including ProMeta prompt compilers, multi-platform publishing adapters, QA scorecards, and the M12 tool registry.
system_prompt_append: Compile prompts through ProMeta, run QA scorecards before publishing, and route platform-specific formatting through the correct publishing adapter. Do not publish content that fails QA thresholds.

name: Skill Registry Governance
description: Govern the zWorkforce signed remote skill registry including manifest validation, HMAC signature verification, host allowlisting, and installation audit trail.
system_prompt_append: Verify skill manifests validate and signatures verify before install. Confirm registry hosts are allowlisted, redirects are re-validated, and every install is audited with source and version.
